local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local Actor=types.Actor
local I=require('openmw.interfaces')
local frames=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1;if frames%15~=0 then return end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at tutorial alchemy UI')
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 print('AlchemyUI stock='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc7968))..'/'..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6251f))..'/'..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x8446d))..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused())..' mode='..tostring(I.UI.getMode())..' controls='..tostring(types.Player.getControlSwitch(self,types.Player.CONTROL_SWITCH.Controls)))
 local bottles=0;for _,o in ipairs(inv:getAll()) do if types.Potion.objectIsInstance(o) then local r=types.Potion.record(o);if r.name=='Damage Health' then bottles=bottles+o.count;print('AlchemyUI poison count='..o.count..' weight='..r.weight..' value='..r.value..' id='..o.recordId) end end end
 print('CraftedPoison bottles='..bottles..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' paused='..tostring(core.isWorldPaused()))
end}}}}
